execute_pipeline_stages: execute a list of pipeline stages on a batch respecting their declared parallelism type
collect_from_main: collect and broadcast batches from main rank across tensor parallel and CFG parallel groups
execute_main_rank_only: execute pipeline stages only on the main rank with barrier synchronization for non-main ranks
execute_cfg_parallel: execute pipeline stages with classifier-free guidance parallel broadcast from rank 0
execute_replicated: execute pipeline stages on all ranks with replicated batch data
